title: Count the F_7-points of a degree-one del Pezzo surface

source.citation: Anthony Varilly-Alvarado and David Zywina, Arithmetic E_8 lattices with maximal Galois action, arXiv:0803.3063

translation.notes: Noether supplies exact F_7 arithmetic while the solution follows the paper's displayed affine-fiber count for w^2=z^3+2x^6+2y^6. It reproduces the bounded base-field count 29, not the F_{7^3} count or the ensuing Frobenius classification.
